Senior Data Scientist - Risk & Credit Modeling
Company: NovaPay is a fintech company (Series D, 400 employees) providing embedded lending and BNPL solutions to enterprise merchants across North America, headquartered in New York, NY.

Location: New York, NY (Hybrid)
Compensation: $175,000 - $210,000 base + equity + performance bonus

About the Role:
We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to lead the development of next-generation credit risk and fraud detection models. You will own the full model lifecycle - from feature engineering and training through deployment and monitoring - and present model performance directly to executive stakeholders and risk committees.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain statistical and ML-based credit risk scoring models used in real-time underwriting decisions
- Conduct deep-dive analyses on portfolio performance, loss rates, and fraud patterns
- Partner with engineering to deploy models via REST APIs into production decisioning systems
- Define and monitor model governance metrics; prepare model risk management documentation
- Mentor junior data scientists and establish modeling best practices across the team
- Collaborate with product and compliance teams to ensure models meet regulatory requirements

Requirements:
- 7+ years of experience in data science, with at least 3 years focused on financial modeling (required)
- Expert-level proficiency in Python for statistical modeling and ML (required)
- Strong SQL skills for feature extraction from large transactional datasets (required)
- Hands-on experience with generalized linear models (GLM, logistic regression, survival analysis) (required)
- Demonstrated experience building and deploying models to production systems (required)
- Understanding of model risk management frameworks (SR 11-7 or equivalent) (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale feature engineering
- Familiarity with SHAP or other explainability frameworks
- Knowledge of fair lending laws and credit model compliance requirements
- Experience with time-series forecasting for financial metrics
- Exposure to graph-based fraud detection methods
